about: Django: URL registrations become route entry points (so click paths, reachability and the login check cover Django views); settings that must not reach production.

rules.title: Django DEBUG is on (stack traces and settings shown to visitors)
rules.fix: Read it from the environment: DEBUG = os.environ.get("DJANGO_DEBUG") == "1", and leave it unset in production.
rules.more: With DEBUG on, any error page lists settings, environment variables and source lines.

rules.title: Django ALLOWED_HOSTS accepts every host name
rules.more: A wildcard lets Host-header attacks build password-reset links that point at an attacker's site.

rules.title: Django SECRET_KEY is written in settings.py
rules.fix: SECRET_KEY = os.environ["DJANGO_SECRET_KEY"]; rotate the old key, since it is in git history.
rules.more: The secret key signs sessions and password-reset tokens. Anyone who reads the repo can forge them.

rules.title: View opts out of CSRF protection (@csrf_exempt)
rules.fix: Remove the exemption; for APIs called by scripts, authenticate with a token instead and keep CSRF for browser sessions.
rules.more: Heuristic: some webhook receivers must be exempt. Check that the view verifies the caller another way.

rules.title: Raw SQL built with string formatting
rules.fix: Pass values as parameters: cursor.execute("... WHERE id = %s", [id]) or Model.objects.raw(sql, [params]).
rules.more: Heuristic: a pattern match on the line, not a data-flow check. The Python scanner (Bandit) reports the certain cases as B608.
